title: Why Self-Checkout Is Quietly Taking Over Grocery Stores
hook: Self-checkout is now almost everywhere, and cashier jobs are quietly disappearing.
closing: The line moved. So did the job.
question: Do you still choose a cashier?

segments.say: In 2023, over 92% of major grocery chains have self-checkout lanes.
US cashier jobs have fallen to about 3 million, down from a higher peak a decade ago.
Self-checkout counters lose merchandise at about 4 percent, more than double a staffed register's rate.
